tools.name: budget_status
tools.description: See how much of the session's budgets (time, money, tokens, disk space) is used, to plan your work within them.

tools.name: decide
tools.description: Ask for a decision you shouldn't make alone: the orchestrator puts the question to a person or a system that decides, and the answer is this call's result. It may take a while. Give the options you see and the context needed to choose.

tools.name: llm
tools.description: Call another model for side work, such as summarising or classifying text, and get its answer. It sees only what you send it and has no tools. Choose a model, or leave it out for the default, fast.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a text file. Lines come numbered; read a large file in parts with offset and limit. Relative paths are relative to workspace/.

tools.name: report_progress
tools.description: Tell the people watching how the task is going: what you are doing now and, if you can tell, how far along you are. Report at milestones, not after every step.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Send feedback to the people running this service: a problem with the task or your setup (a missing tool, unclear instructions, bad input), a suggestion, or a question. It doesn't wait for an answer.

tools.name: spawn_subagent
tools.description: start a subagent on a subtask

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create or overwrite a file with the given content. Missing directories are created. inputs/ is read-only; put deliverables in output/.
